name: Tsujimura Renji
source:
“The greatest mysteries don’t come from plot twists or bizarre occurrences.
––It’s when nobody’s able to find the body.”

Though he’s still a student, he’s a published author with up-and-coming newcomer awards under his belt. He has a tendency to ask lots of questions, and speaks as though he’s trying to control the conversation. He’s arrogant, proud, and doesn’t hold back his opinions, and though he considers himself an intellectual who favours debate, when he gets annoyed he’s quick to start a fight. He’s in charge of cooking at the Ghost Tower. The taste isn’t bad but it leaves something to be desired.
He’s cocky towards Shiramine, but is weak to Izumi.

[Source: [url=http://www.tarhs.com/chara.html]official website profile[/url]]
